svg.title: Kiki guide moves contact sheet
svg.text: Halo and filled number = step now · ghost number on a dashed path = steps ahead · tick = done · dots = where Kiki flew from
Both join A and B: parallel
Your turn: tap the part in series
Watch: pick it up, drop it here
R1 and R2: series or parallel?
Listening: say it in your words
Which one do you mean: a or b?
